name: Slider
summary: Drawn slider: label and value on top, a 20 track with the fill, a capsule thumb. One value or a range of two, horizontal or vertical, number formatted by Intl.

a11y.keyboardNote: Each thumb is a slider; the engine (Base UI 1.6) gives the eight keys, Shift + arrow for the large step. The visible label names the thumbs; with two values, thumbLabels names each one.

props.name: label
props.description: REQUIRED. Names the thumbs. labelHidden keeps it for screen readers only.

props.name: labelHidden
props.description: Hides the label from the screen, keeps it as the accessible name.

props.name: value / defaultValue
props.description: A number, or a list of two for a range (two thumbs).

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called on every step with the number (or the list).

props.name: onValueCommitted
props.description: Called when the thumb is released — the moment to save.

props.name: largeStep
props.description: The step for Page Up/Down and Shift + arrow.

props.name: orientation
props.description: Vertical stacks value, track and label; its height is --range-vertical-size.

props.name: format / locale
props.description: How the value is written (currency, percent…), by the platform's Intl.

props.name: showValue
props.description: Shows the value next to the label.

props.name: thumbLabels
props.description: With two values, each thumb's name, in order ("Minimum", "Maximum").

props.name: name
props.description: For the form: the engine renders the hidden input with the raw value.

props.name: className
props.description: Merged onto the outermost element, after the Aurea skin.

props.name: id
props.description: The id of the slider root.
